# Synthetic Case corpus for `make record-fixtures`.
#
# Checked into the repository and deliberately dull. A recording made against a
# user's evals would commit their questions to this repo forever, and CLAUDE.md
# is explicit that traces are customer data. Lines beginning with # are ignored;
# every other non-blank line is one Case input.
#
# Each line is chosen to provoke one recordable outcome:

What is the capital of France? Answer with the city name only.
Write the word "yes" and nothing else.
Count from one to five, separated by commas.
Explain, in one sentence, what an eval harness measures.
Repeat the following exactly: kno-fixture-marker.
